# ohAegCheckSignRSAWithPSSText

ohAegCheckSignRSAWithPSSText(text: string \| Uint8Array, pubKey: string \| Uint8Array, sign: string \| Uint8Array): Promise\<boolean\>

RSA3072公钥验签，配套[ohAegSignRSAWithPSSText](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/AppGallery-connect-References/ohaegsignrsawithpsstext-0000001910388781)和[ohAegSignRSAWithPSSTextBase64](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/AppGallery-connect-References/ohaegsignrsawithpsstextbase64-0000001864508922)接口使用，密钥类型、填充模式、摘要算法等如下：  

|非对称密钥类型|填充模式|摘要算法|掩码摘要|API版本|
|:------|:---|:-----|:----------|:----|
|RSA3072|PSS|SHA256|MGF1_SHA256|11+|

导入模块：

```
import { AegRsaSign } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';
```

参数：  

|参数名|类型|必填|说明|
|:-----|:----------------|:-|:-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|text|string或Uint8Array|是|待验签的原文。|
|pubKey|string或Uint8Array|是|验签使用的RSA公钥，base64编码过的字符串或Uint8Array。|
|sign|string或Uint8Array|是|签名值（通过ohAegSignRSAWithPSSText或者ohAegSignRSAWithPSSTextBase64签名后的结果）。|

返回值：  

|参数|类型|说明|
|:---|:------|:------------------------|
|验签结果|boolean|返回验签结果，true:通过，false:不通过。|

示例一：

```
import { AegRsaSign } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';

async function rsasign3072_1() {
  let plainText = 'hello world'; //待签名内容
  //用于签名的私钥，长度3072位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let priKey = '';
  //用于验签的公钥，长度3027位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let pubKey = '';

  try {
    let signText = await AegRsaSign.ohAegSignRSAWithPSSText(plainText, priKey);
    //rsasign3072_1  signText: 152,226,108,22,102,105,62,33,71,244,165,53,19,177,34,78,40,215,149,240,88,84,54,199,232,159,176,34,145,40,235,186,212,222,242,252,97,199,208,84,90,156,11,249,24,38,60,100,248,70,218,160,222,245,5,99,162,161,68,100,196,58,171,83,33,57,149,242,103,149,146,177,186,55,108,197,12,94,7,249,17,182,252,231,217,184,198,183,66,130,222,252,229,28,231,46,22,135,105,117,188,223,154,136,33,39,141,157,57,149,70,72,133,1,141,21,118,176,233,234,131,193,96,78,52,69,193,32,217,100,163,252,110,177,218,49,231,166,72,160,137,232,161,173,49,47,26,251,22,242,192,196,81,59,84,36,241,15,164,6,18,37,199,106,216,164,220,58,19,79,165,39,140,33,188,73,216,177,2,59,114,101,247,90,38,90,150,40,57,59,86,31,156,31,72,180,152,161,178,245,100,161,171,164,36,67,72,23,227,0,235,222,171,43,12,36,223,119,129,115,71,83,83,44,232,237,126,245,99,121,64,13,130,65,36,159,31,9,220,104,241,182,140,212,78,244,235,244,154,39,199,74,39,5,191,107,101,158,169,202,219,139,11,148,202,236,12,164,128,145,203,225,215,89,12,219,180,29,172,249,146,10,179,195,83,138,103,123,197,43,207,236,98,92,93,180,123,17,94,95,106,36,128,128,61,141,100,193,92,157,58,229,13,126,88,237,71,173,51,111,226,148,11,234,126,209,251,166,183,145,173,177,190,111,37,147,35,178,209,143,17,240,199,32,226,190,208,138,139,152,19,48,221,8,15,0,41,41,38,52,102,205,89,21,119,9,99,25,98,159,205,44,204,234,30,3,126,13,71,102,180,174,150,140
    console.log("rsasign3072_1 ", 'signText: ' + signText);

    let decryptText = await AegRsaSign.ohAegCheckSignRSAWithPSSText(plainText, pubKey, signText);
    if (decryptText == true) {
      console.info('rsasign3072_1 verify ok');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("rsasign3072_1 ", 'err: ' + err);
  }
}
```

示例二：

```
import { AegRsaSign } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';

async function rsasign3072_2() {
  let plainText = 'hello world'; //待签名内容
  //用于签名的私钥，长度3072位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let priKey = '';
  //用于验签的公钥，长度3072位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let pubKey = '';

  try {
    let signText = await AegRsaSign.ohAegSignRSAWithPSSTextBase64(plainText, priKey);
    //rsasign3072_2  signText: 
    console.log("rsasign3072_2 ", 'signText: ' + signText);

    let decryptText = await AegRsaSign.ohAegCheckSignRSAWithPSSText(plainText, pubKey, signText);

    if (decryptText == true) {
      console.info('rsasign3072_2 verify ok');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("rsasign3072_2 ", 'err: ' + err);
  }
}
```
